== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns John Glasgow in Rashlie, Kilbride, 1643. John Glasgow was listed as “in Rashlie, parish of Kilbride” in a printed index to Glasgow Commissary Court testaments, dated 17 April 1643.<ref>FamilySearch, ''Glasgow. Wills 1547–1800'', item #007960708, image 112, printed index p. 196, entry for John Glasgow in Rashlie, parish of Kilbride, 17 April 1643, reference CC9/7/28; https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS8K-D98V?view=fullText&keywords=Glasgow&searchForm=advanced&lang=en&groupId=M97N-2NT. The image is of the printed index, not the underlying testament.</ref> The identification remains uncertain.
